Verta tariff schedule
## FX spreads by tier
The spread is applied over the mid-market rate only after the free monthly
conversion allowance is exhausted.

| Tier | FX spread | Free monthly conversion allowance |
|---|---|---|
| Tier 1 | 1.5% | EUR 500 |
| Tier 2 | 0.9% | EUR 1,000 |
| Tier 3 | 0.5% | EUR 5,000 |

Currency conversion guide
## How a conversion is priced
A conversion quote has these components, in order: the mid-market rate for the
currency pair; the tier spread (a percentage of the gross converted amount);
the free monthly conversion allowance. If the whole conversion fits within the
customer's remaining monthly allowance, no spread is charged. Once the
allowance is exhausted, the full tier spread applies to the conversion.

Currency conversion operations
## Allowance accounting
The free monthly conversion allowance is counted in EUR equivalent and resets on
the first calendar day of each month. Allowance consumption is recorded at
settlement. A conversion that would cross the allowance boundary has the tier
spread applied to the entire conversion, not only to the portion above the
boundary.

Currency conversion guide
## Reading a quote
A complete quote lists: mid rate, spread percentage applied, allowance total
and allowance used before this conversion, gross converted amount, spread
amount, and the final credited amount. The final amount equals the gross
amount minus the spread amount.

spreads, allowances and transfer limits.

Verta tariff schedule
## FX spreads by tier
The spread is applied over the mid-market rate only after the free monthly
conversion allowance is exhausted.

| Tier | FX spread | Free monthly conversion allowance |
|---|---|---|
| Tier 1 | 1.5% | EUR 500 |
| Tier 2 | 0.9% | EUR 1,000 |
| Tier 3 | 0.5% | EUR 5,000 |

Onboarding and tiers
## How a customer gets a tier
New customers start on Tier 1. Tier 2 is granted when the average monthly
inflow exceeds EUR 3,000 over three consecutive months. Tier 3 is granted on
application and is reviewed annually.

Currency conversion guide
## How a conversion is priced
A conversion quote has these components, in order: the mid-market rate for the
currency pair; the tier spread (a percentage of the gross converted amount);
the free monthly conversion allowance. If the whole conversion fits within the
customer's remaining monthly allowance, no spread is charged. Once the
allowance is exhausted, the full tier spread applies to the conversion.

Currency conversion operations
## Allowance accounting
The free monthly conversion allowance is counted in EUR equivalent and resets on
the first calendar day of each month. Allowance consumption is recorded at
settlement. A conversion that would cross the allowance boundary has the tier
spread applied to the entire conversion, not only to the portion above the
boundary.

Currency conversion operations
## When a conversion happens
A conversion happens when the payment currency differs from the currency of the
account being debited. The conversion is applied at settlement, not at
authorisation.
